intro: Lesson 35. Question: does the height of a ramp change how far a toy car rolls? Use the data to plan, calculate, draw a graph and conclude.

questions.q: Name one variable kept the same.
questions.a: The car, the surface, or how the car was released (no push)

questions.q: Find the mean distance for each ramp height. Leave out any anomaly.
questions.a: 10 cm: 52; 20 cm: 100; 30 cm: 150; 40 cm: 200 (160 left out as an anomaly)

questions.q: Draw a line graph of the means on the grid. Label both axes with units.
questions.a: Ramp height (cm) along the bottom; mean distance (cm) up the side; four points plotted and joined; a rising line
The higher the ramp, the further the car rolls (about 50 cm more for each 10 cm of height).
For example: more repeats, measure with a tape fixed to the floor, release the car the same way every time.
